description: Triage support tickets by urgency, team and churn risk (guide page 5).
context_hint: include the customer's plan and tenure in each item when you have them

urgency.instructions: How soon does the ticket in `item` need an answer?

team.instructions: Which team should take the ticket in `item`?

churn_risk.instructions: How likely is this customer to leave?
criteria: Has set a deadline to leave
